freeware.release_notes: v1.1.11: fixed duplicate/orphaned Ollama daemons. Root cause: (1) 'ollama list .is_ok()' treated any exit (incl. 'could not connect') as daemon-up, so VERA bailed into 'already running' and never spawned; (2) list_installed_models fallback spawned a bare unmanaged 'ollama serve' (no env, no owner, never killed) whenever the daemon was down - producing 2 daemons and dropped-connection gaps. Now: proper exit-code check, single spawn site (start_inference_server), kill+wait on stop/reset/exit (port released before respawn), and every spawn/reuse/kill is timestamped with PID and reason in ~/.lexsort/logs/ollama-lifecycle.log.

pro.release_notes: Rotated license public key, fixed Windows compilation, updated modules signatures, and released new installers.
